producedBy.note: remotePreimage equals candidate.commit, independently confirming the R2 execute step's push would be a provable no-op for this already-published candidate.

blockedBy.detail: preparePublicationTransaction's requireSuccessfulGate demands, for the critic gate specifically, a native critic-evidence record with review.verdict === 'pass' AND review.findings.length === 0. The only real candidate-bound Critic review available (specs/sprint-nova-epic/evidence/nova-a/a5/critic-convergence-report-d5be0e6.json) has 2 findings. The generic pipeline.nova-a-gate-observation.v1 wrapper schema would structurally satisfy the check regardless of finding count, but using it here would mean self-attesting a 'passed' critic gate for a review that did not actually clear cleanly -- exactly the fabrication publication-gate-evidence.mjs's own docstring says this mechanism must never allow. Not used.

specs/sprint-nova-epic/evidence/nova-a/a6/release-preflight-record-57ee7e9.json (real, from the NOVA-A56-EVIDENCE-1 dispatch) reports status: blocked, reasons: [repository-not-clean, consent-not-approved] for a synthetic declined consent input. No real PO consent artifact exists for this candidate. preparePublicationTransaction requires releasePreflight.record.status === 'ready'. This is a genuine external precondition, not derivable from any artifact already in the repository.
